summary: Re-test of ITER160 P0 fixes from iteration_4. BOTH P0 fixes verified: (1) Admin endpoints now strictly enforce auth — anonymous and wrong-key requests return 401; X-Admin-Key=dev (matching ADMIN_API_KEY env) and valid Bearer JWT (admin@moodfordesign.com) both return 200. (2) Ecosystem pre-suggestion now works for all three sentinel archetypes (luxury_showroom, interior_studio, architecture_firm) — bands correctly render 'inclusa nella tua composizione' for archetype_to_suggested keys and 'non per ora' for others. Sentinel regression checks all green: BACKEND-C happy submit returns MOOD-XXXX-XXXX reference; FRONTEND-H Identity chips render Italian labels (Residenziale privato, Italiano, English, Quieto, Composto, Vivido) when /studio/identity is loaded fresh; FRONTEND-I request reception is now combined into /studio/identity scrolled page with INVIA LA RICHIESTA submit (Movement IV + Movement V composed in same view — copy reads 'IL VOSTRO RIFERIMENTO' section). Zero-jargon sweep CLEAN across /studio, /studio/practice, /studio/ecosystem, /studio/identity, /studio/request. Backend pytest: 19 PASS / 1 skipped (cleanup, no DB URL exposed in test env).

issues: React hydration warning '<a> cannot be a descendant of <a>' in LocaleProvider/Routes tree — still present (P2, not retested fully).

action_items: Optional: address /studio/request being effectively merged into /studio/identity — confirm intent (Movement IV + Movement V on one scroll). Currently `identity-continue` testid no longer exists; submit is `INVIA LA RICHIESTA`. If by design, update old test scripts accordingly.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routers/_auth.py now correctly hardens admin endpoints. Bearer JWT path validates role ∈ {admin, owner, editor}; X-Admin-Key path requires ADMIN_API_KEY env to be set; anonymous → 401. Good fix — removes the previous bypass.

MovementPractice.onSelect now patches archetype + suggested experiences into the draft (per archetype_to_suggested map), which lets MovementEcosystem render the curated pre-marked bands on first render with no client-side derivation needed. Clean fix.
MovementEcosystem adoption useEffect now waits for manifestReady — eliminates the race where the map was empty on first paint.

rca_of_the_issue.iteration_4_admin_auth_bypass: Was: require_admin_tenant only enforced ADMIN_API_KEY when env var was set; unset env = unrestricted access. Fix verified: new _auth.py raises 401 unless valid Bearer JWT with admin/owner/editor role OR X-Admin-Key matching configured ADMIN_API_KEY=dev. Curl matrix: no-auth=401, bogus-key=401, key=dev=200, JWT=200.
rca_of_the_issue.iteration_4_ecosystem_no_suggestions: Was: MovementEcosystem derived included-state only from draft.experiences (empty after practice → all bands 'non per ora'). Fix verified: MovementPractice.onSelect now patches archetype_to_suggested[archetype] into draft.experiences, so ecosystem reads pre-marked bands directly. Visual screenshot confirmed for all 3 archetypes (luxury_showroom, interior_studio, architecture_firm).
